simple.meaning: רָפֶה (râpheh) is a Hebrew word meaning “slack (in body or mind).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רָפֶה (H7504) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 13:18, with occurrences in Numbers, 2 Samuel, Job, Isaiah.

definitions.usage: weak. raphah, Raphah. See 7497 , 7498 . riphah. See 7383 .
definitions.full: H7504. rapheh רָפֶה adjective slack ; — absolute ׳ר , of people, Num 13:18 (J); construct יָרַיִם רְפֵה 2Sam 17:2 , i.e. weak (|| יָגֵעַ ); feminine plural רָפוֺת יָרַיִם , figurative of discouragement and fear Isa 35:3 ; Job 4:3 . compare v Qal 2.
